l15.description: Metadata analysis: AUTH, tool description injection, input validation, CORS, OAuth scopes, rate limiting error leakage

l16.description: Enhanced static analysis: 18 MCP-specific Semgrep rules (prompt injection, command injection, secrets, SSRF, path traversal, tool spoofing), 18 secret detection patterns (Stripe, AWS, GitHub, wallets, JWT, etc.), OSV dependency vulnerability check

l2.sandbox: Docker with --network none, --read-only, --cap-drop ALL, seccomp, 256MB memory
l2.monitors: stdout, filesystem changes, network attempts, crashes
l2.description: Dynamic behavioral analysis in isolated Docker container. Results committed to catalog as static sentinel scores.

honest_assessment.summary: L1.5 + L1.6 run IN REAL-TIME on every /api/audit-skill call. L2 runs via GitHub Actions on submission. All three layers contribute to the final Sentinel score.
strengths: L1.6 runs in REAL-TIME on every API call (18 Semgrep rules + 18 secret patterns + OSV API)
Weighted scoring: secrets 40%, vulns 30%, static 20%, hygiene 10%
L2 Docker sandbox available via GitHub Actions (--network none, --read-only, --cap-drop ALL)
All code is open source and auditable
weaknesses: L1.6 analyzes metadata and descriptions, not full source code (L2 handles source code via GitHub Actions)
L2 does not run on every API call — only on submission via GitHub Actions
Regex-based detection can be evaded by obfuscation
No independent third-party audit yet (deferred until revenue)
